title: Payment for Rental of Sports Hub for Extra Rehearsal Days for National Day Parade
what_it_is: Payment for Rental of Sports Hub for Extra Rehearsal Days for National Day Parade

sections.label: NDP venue costs
sections.summary: Past NDPs at Marina Bay cost $15.7m to $17.9m, the Padang $20.6m in 2010 and $40.5m in 2015, and the National Stadium about $39.4m this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Previous NDPs at the Marina Bay Platform cost between $15.7 million and $17.9 million.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The cost of NDP at the Padang in 2010 was $20.6 million and, in 2015, $40.5 million.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The cost of NDP at the National Stadium this year is expected to be about $39.4 million.

sections.label: Venue cost percentages
sections.summary: Venue costs are about 4% of total costs at public sites Marina Bay Floating Platform and Padang, and about 15% at the National Stadium.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Venue costs, which was the question asked, are expected to be very low for public sites at the Marina Bay Floating Platform and the Padang – about 4% of total costs – because the Padang and the Marina Bay Floating Platform are public sites.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: For NDP 2016 at the National Stadium, the venue cost is about 15% of total costs, similar to other national events held at private venues.

sections.label: Private venue contract terms
sections.summary: The contract was negotiated in the usual way with private providers at 15% of total show cost, and venue cost rose from 4% to 15%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The contract was negotiated as is, in the usual way that we negotiate with private providers and it is 15% of the total cost of the show, which is equivalent to the cost of public events held at private venues.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Whether there is recourse for dispute 	Page: 21 resolution, I expect that it will be similar to all public contracts held in private venues as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: I understand that the proportion of the amount spent this time has gone up from 4% to 15% just for venue cost.

sections.label: Sports Hub rental and budget
sections.summary: The Member asks the Minister to confirm Sports Hub rental is under $6 million and whether itemised MINDEF costs will appear in Budget 2016.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: The Minister mentioned that the 15% is a figure.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: So, I would like him to confirm that what he is saying is that the rental cost of the Sports Hub is calculated to be under $6 million.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: The next question is: will the detailed figures be provided in the Government Budget in the coming Budget for 2016 in terms of the itemised costs for MINDEF?

sections.label: Dispute resolution question deferred
sections.summary: The Minister lacks the detailed answer on dispute resolution, asks for a separate question, and says spectators will more than double.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: I do not have the detailed answer to that question.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: So, if the Member could file it as a separate question about dispute resolution, I will be happy to answer it or get the relevant party to answer it.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: I have just given the cost for this year's NDP 2016.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: I have provided many figures, including the fact that the number of spectators in the show that can be physically there will be more than double.
